- **Dogs interaction with crows 2** Crows can ride the dogs
- **Dogs interaction with cats** The dogs can BARK at cats when too close, they can chase one another shortly.
- **Dogs interaction to attacks** The dogs will BITE you. 5 bites per dog, If another dog is nearby they can team up on you.

cards.title: Phones
cards.desc:
# Phones

## Opening Your Phone:

To open your phone, press Alt/D-Pad Down, which will greet you with this UI:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a66a9defaa4c76b07d0b643/previews/6a66a9dffaa4c76b07d0bfb7/download/image.webp)

To progress past this screen, press the “OK” button, which will open a menu that features all of the apps:

Once you are here, you can use the arrow keys on the phone to navigate or alternatively click on the apps.

# Apps:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb8346aef5eaf64d7e1b7/previews/6a7cb8356aef5eaf64d7e3a7/download/image.webp)

## **My Phone:**

the My Phone app displays the following information about you:

- Phone Number
- Yen
- Total Contacts
- Messages Sent
- Total Messages Received
- Phone Model
- Calls
- Call Time
- And Carrier
- Weather
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c20472399ec1003a0c9/previews/6a726c21472399ec1003a1f1/download/image.webp)

## **Dial:**

Dial allows you to dial players phone numbers. Furthermore, by dialing peoples phone numbers you can save them as a contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf4ce/previews/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf6ce/download/image.webp)

## **Calls:**

Calls shows all past calls (which also allows you to save contacts after a call)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb881275df5c4e7493ff3/previews/6a7cb883275df5c4e749417b/download/image.webp)

## **Contacts:**

Contacts shows a list of all saved contacts

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726ca69a246e8612cd6197/previews/6a726ca69a246e8612cd62e3/download/image.webp)

## **Games:**

The Games app opens a menu that lets you select various phone games to play.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cb7d05cb4df2f129d3d/previews/6a726cb8d05cb4df2f129e95/download/image.webp)

## **Social Link:**

Social link allows two players to connect phone numbers without the trouble of dialing them. To use it, both players must open social link in proximity to each other. After locating the person you want, click “OK” and save their contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4e6f/previews/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4f62/download/image.webp)

## **Mixi:**

Mixi is an in game global social media app, that allows you to create posts, and like/comment other people’s posts. To create a post, click the left pad next to the arrow keys.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7959262cc8c5b54cdd10/previews/6a6e795b262cc8c5b54cde11/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7ac7f1f6a3cfa75cf90e/previews/6a6e7ac8f1f6a3cfa75cfb47/download/image.webp)

## **Camera:**

The Camera app allows players to take photos using their in game phone.

To use it:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Camera**.
3. Switch between 3 different custom filters for different vibes.
4. Switch between **front** and **back** camera.
5. Take a photo.

- **Back Camera** – Captures the world, environments, and other players.
- **Front Camera** – Takes selfies of your character.
  ![Screenshot\_2026-07-11\_131704.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a52da71070234ae653b984e/previews/6a52da71070234ae653b9912/download/Screenshot_2026-07-11_131704.webp)

Photos can be taken instantly anywhere in the world.

**Saving Photos (Roblox Captures)**

After taking a photo, players can save it to Roblox:

1. Open the photo preview.
2. Select **Save to Captures**.

The image is stored in your **Roblox Captures** and can be accessed outside the game through your Roblox account.

## **Japanify:**

is your built in music collection, allowing players to browse and listen to music with ease. You can view your **liked songs**, explore **playlists**, listen to music from your favorite **artists**, and search for **recently added songs**, all from one convenient interface. It's designed to make discovering and organizing music simple while enhancing your in game experience.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cd641f9ad89c1bb1af2/previews/6a726cd741f9ad89c1bb1c56/download/image.webp)

## **YenApp:**

**Tags:** Choosing a tag is essentially your username on the app, it is what players type in when they want to send you money. After choosing a tag you will be greeted with this screen:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce096a8/previews/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce09792/download/image.webp)

The Activity button will show all transactions. You can search other players tags by clicking the black bar and typing in their name.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a701ba6b8ca6b95cde9b3c7/previews/6a701ba7b8ca6b95cde9b59e/download/image.webp)

Is a simple application that allows players to apply for shifts at different Job locations for Yen!

There are 5 clubs you can choose from, join one at its board in the club room. The 5 clubs include Biology Club, Calligraphy Club, Astronomy Club, Gardening Club, and Light Music Club.

Club uniforms can be accessed at any time from their respective club boards after reaching 1,000 points in that club.

‌

**Biology Club**

The Biology club is found on the first floor to the left of the entrance and beside the locker area. Upon joining the biology club, your task for getting points is finding specimen via the microscope. You unlock more specimens to find as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

Upon joining the calligraphy club, your task for getting points is writing calligraphy. The calligraphy that you have to write is random. You unlock more kanji to write as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

## NPC Events

> Automobiles (of various colors and models) can be found driven by NPCs on the roads outside of Nishikata High—this includes: smaller two-door cars, four-door cars, small trucks, small vans, semi-trucks, and taxis.

Running into vehicles moving at a substantial speed will cause you to take damage, knockback, and you'll be ragdolled for a couple of seconds.

Whilst riding a skateboard, moving in close proximity to the rear end of a vehicle (with the exception of semi-trucks) will force your character to grab onto one of the rear corners of the vehicle, allowing you to hitch a ride by hanging on. You can stop this action at any time by simply tapping "s" (backward movement key).

You are able to attack vehicles with your fists—they aren't destructible, but the NPC inside the vehicle will show dialogue in complaint to your actions.
In some cases, continuing to attack the vehicle will result in the NPC exiting the vehicle and aggroing you.
If enough damage to the NPC is dealt, they will re-enter the vehicle and flee the scene.

Student council waits outside of the gate with 1 teacher, 3 student councils and greet you / tell you to hurry to class

cards.title: Instruments
cards.desc:
The game features a variety of playable instruments that use a rhythm-based gameplay system similar to popular music games. There are two **music rooms** located on the third floor of the school. Instead of simply activating an instrument, players must hit incoming notes with proper timing to perform songs successfully.

Notes travel down designated lanes toward target circles. As each note reaches its target, players press the corresponding key at the correct moment — the accuracy of the input determines the quality of the hit.

**Click** [**here**](https://trello.com/c/wQkJJHPV "‌") **to view a list of all playable songs by instrument**

**Note Ratings**

- **Perfect** — exceptional timing and accuracy.
- **Good** — slightly off but still accurate.
- **Okay** — acceptable timing with noticeable error.
- **Bad** — poor timing or a near miss, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.
- **Miss** - complete miss of the note, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.

Percentage accuracy is based on the amount of Perfect, Good, and Okay notes, divided by the total amount of notes in the song.

![instrument.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a7292e7687caa386a4f9817/download/instrument.gif)

**100 Note Combo Vfx**:

![out.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6aa5d33c54fef7fd472bac8d/previews/6aa5d35254fef7fd472bc9e2/download/out.gif)

---

**Calibration**

- You can calibrate your timing to what feels right for you.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa67b72bec1ec92bdda9/previews/6a77aa68b72bec1ec92bde58/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa6e849e167d7f038048/previews/6a77aa6f849e167d7f038103/download/image.webp)

---

**Available Instruments**

**Electric Guitar**

- Uses two note lanes.
- Played with the `F` and `J` keys. (Keys are rebind-able in settings)
- Designed for a simpler but fast-paced rhythm experience.

**Bass Guitar**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Hit notes across four separate paths using the assigned keys.

**Drums**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Accurately match incoming drum notes across all four lanes to maintain rhythm.

**Keyboard**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Focuses on timing and accuracy across multiple paths to simulate playing a song on a keyboard.

**Piano**

- Uses Roblox Virtual Piano letter-based keyboard notes.
- Only instrument not based on a **rhythm-based gameplay system**
- Press SPACE to bring up the sheet music list.

‌

Each instrument has its own feel while following the same core mechanics. Success depends on **timing, rhythm, and accuracy**  not character stats.

---

**Multiplayer Performance**
Instruments fully support synchronized group performances. When a player starts a song, others can join at any time and are automatically placed at the exact same point in the song.

- Multiple players can perform together simultaneously.
- Players who join late are auto-synced to the current section of the song.
- Everyone plays the same song at the same time.
- Performances stay synchronized for all participating musicians.

For example, one player can perform on electric guitar while others join on bass, drums, or piano each synced to the same song progression, creating the feeling of playing together as a **live band**.

---

**Customization**

cards.title: Glasses
cards.desc:
**Glasses**

Glasses are face accessories that you can roll for through the game's accessory system. they let you customize your avatar's appearance and come in 2 distinct styles. 

• **Thick Black Glasses**- a more larger, bolder look that stands out on your face.

• **Thin Black Glasses**-a sleeker, more subtle style for a cleaner look. 

Aside from looking clean and nice, wearing glasses introduces a unique mechanic during combat. 

**What Occurs During Combat With Glasses**
If you take a heavy enough punch to the face, your glasses can get knocked completely off and drop to the ground. 

**What happens your glasses fly off:**

 • They are instantly unequipped 

 • Your screen becomes blurred, impairing your vision.

 • This blur effect stays on your screen until you get your glasses back.

**How to restore your normal vision**

• Locate where your glasses fell

• pick them up and equip them 

Once re-equipped, the blur effect clears up immediately.

cards.title: Activities
cards.desc:
**Chess:**

Chess is a classical game of skill played between two players tfound in the Board Game room.

- 2 players are required to play chess
- There are NPC’s found in the chess room with varying skill to play against

Note that: Chess pieces can still be moved without another player in the seat, meaning you don’t need another person to activate the game.

---

**Connect Four**

A classic two-player game located in the Chess Clubroom. Players take turns dropping colored discs into a vertical grid, and the first to line up four of their discs in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — wins. A quick, easy way to challenge friends between activities.

---

**Karaoke**

Step into a lively karaoke bar where music, laughter, and good times come together. Guest can choose their favorite songs, sing on stage with friends or they can cheer you on! With colorful lights, energetic music, refreshing drinks from the vending machine outside. It's the perfect place to relax after having a dinner at _Dante's Yakiniku Restaurant_ or after the school day. _**To play a song**_, interact with either the Television or I-pad on the table (songs cost 100¥ to play).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a80d300dc41240ba6bdfdd9/previews/6a80d302dc41240ba6be01d9/download/image.webp)

---

**Arm Wrestling** A quick fun game of arm wrestling located on-top the roof or in the cafe, consisting of quick time events between two players, timing your inputs to best the other player. **How do scores work?** Different Scores: _Miss/Ok/Good/Perfect_

- The **CLOSER** you and your opponents scores are, the **LESS** the one with less is pushed back.
- The **FARTHER** you and your opponents scores are, the **MORE** the one with less is pushed back

![armwrestling.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a79d824fd17219bccd0108a/previews/6a79d82ffd17219bccd022a4/download/armwrestling.gif)

The player guides a bright yellow circular character with a wide mouth through a closed maze. The goal is to eat all small dots while avoiding four colorful ghosts. Eating flashing "**Power Pellets**" lets Pac-Man temporarily eat the ghosts. Eating fruits awards bonus points.

cards.title: NPC Interaction
cards.desc:
## NPCs:

Each NPC has a different personality which means that each of them can speak differently. They're able to read their stats such as grade, age, height and ethnicity which all alter how they will/can answer. NPCs are also able to read your own stats and mention them in a conversation.

---

## Commands:

You can use commands such as /s to shout or whisper and they'll whisper/shout back at you (not always). Some NPCs do not like shouting or will find it weird to shout.

---

## Memory:

NPCs can remember you. If you tell an NPC their name, they'll remember it and when you go away and come back to ask them "do you know me" they'll mention your name and say how you were here a second ago.

---

## Time:

NPC interactions also depend on time. When it's morning and a class is starting, they'll tell you how it's time to go to class
they're able to mention the time and which class you need be in, if you ask them which class to go some will say the exact time of how long it'll last

---

## Locations:

NPCs know their location, depending on where they stand, they'll mention it if you ask them and also what class you must be

# **Basketball:**

is a skill-based activity focused on **timing, ball control, positioning, and defensive pressure**. Basketballs can be found on the racks near the hoop.

**Shooting:**

- Hold `E` to begin your shooting motion - a shot meter starts filling
- Release `E` to shoot
- The timing of your release determines the quality of the shot.
- Press Shift + Spacebar to perform a Dunk near the rim
- Shift + Tapping `E` to perform a Euro Step Dunk
- Press `G` to post up, `G+E` allows you to do a Post Fadeaway

## Power Meter Settings

Choose the style of the **Power Meter** that appears beside you whenever your basketball power changes. **Available Power Meters:**

- BALL • BATTERY • BLADE • CLASSIC
- DIAL • ENSO • GAUGE • HANABI

- MILK • MINI • RETICLE • RHYTHM
- OFF

**Shot Meter Zones**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6ac16b60b79679d36c1f2576/previews/6ac16b61b79679d36c1f2653/download/image.webp)

**Three-Point Scoring**
On both the Courtyard and Indoor Basketball courts, there are large semi-circles(the yellow line indoors and one of the white lines in the courtyard) that form a perimeter around the hoops on each side of the court.

These semi-circles are your **Three-Point Lines**.

They represent the perimeter by which any shot made past them(closer to the half-court line) will count for 3 points, however any shots made closer to the goal will instead only court for 2 points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211c34/previews/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211cde/download/image.webp)

---

**Defensive Pressure:**
Shot timing isn't the only factor. An active defender's positioning and pressure can reduce the shooter's chance of making the basket.

- Open shots are easier to make.
- Lightly contested shots are more difficult.
- Heavily contested shots are significantly harder to score.
- Strong pressure can lower shooting effectiveness even on otherwise decent releases.

Creating space before shooting is often just as important as timing the shot itself.

**Ball Handling:**
Several dribble moves let you create separation and outmaneuver defenders.

- `X` — Bounce-Back Dribble
- `Z + X` — Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `C + X` — Alternate Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `Backspace` — Drop the Ball
- Ball in right hand, `C+C`  — Right Spin Move
- Ball in left hand, `Z+Z`— Left Spin Move
- `Z or X` — Swap ball to other hand.

cards.title: Messages
cards.desc:
**Messaging System**

Players can communicate with one another through the in game messaging system, regardless of their location in the world.

Before a player can send messages, they must first add the other character through [https://trello.com/c/0hQv7H95/98-socialink](https://trello.com/c/0hQv7H95/98-socialink "smartCard-inline") , the phone feature used to manage connections and contacts. Once two characters are connected through Social Link, they will appear in each other's contact lists.

To send a message:

1. Open your phone.
2. Navigate to **Contacts**.
3. Select the person you wish to message.
4. Press **Message** to open the conversation.
5. Type and send your text.

The recipient will receive the message and can respond by opening their phone and viewing the conversation. Characters do not need to be physically near each other to exchange messages, allowing communication from anywhere in the game world.

All conversations are stored in the message history and can be revisited at any time through the phone.

cards.title: Contacts
cards.desc:
**Contacts**

The Contacts app functions similarly to a regular smartphone contact list, allowing players to call players and store and manage people they know. Calling allows players to talk through **Voice Chat** through the calling feature,

When a character is added through **Social Link**, their information is automatically saved to your Contacts list. From there, you can easily access their profile, send messages, and interact with them through supported phone features.

To use Contacts:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Contacts**.
3. Browse your saved contacts or choose a specific person.
4. Open their contact page to view available actions.

The Contacts app serves as a convenient way to keep track of friends you meet throughout the game. Any player added through Social Link will remain in your Contacts.

Contacts are organized for quick access, making it easy to find and communicate with people without needing to search for them each time.

cards.title: Home Screen
cards.desc:
# Greeting Screen

This screen will show up whenever you open your phone, showing a menu button, the time, date, and multiple flowers below. Pressing OK (or the respective key-bind) will direct you to the Apps Screen. You can also press the side buttons to immediately go to either the message or telephone app.

cards.title: Games
cards.desc:
**Games**

The Games app allows players to enjoy a collection of classic mobile games directly from their phone in game. Whether you're waiting for a friend, relaxing between activities, or simply looking to pass the time, the Games app provides a variety of familiar arcade style experiences.

To access the Games app:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Games**.
3. Choose a game from the available library.
4. Start playing instantly.

The game library includes popular classics such as:

- **Snake** – Guide a growing snake around the screen while avoiding collisions.
- **Flappy Bird** – Navigate through obstacles by timing your taps carefully.
- **2048** – Combine matching numbered tiles to reach the highest score possible.
- And many other classic and retro inspired games.

Each game can be played directly from your phone without leaving the game world, offering a fun distraction whenever you need a break. Additional games may be added over time, expanding the collection of available activities.

Whether you're competing for high scores or simply playing for fun, the Games app brings a piece of classic mobile gaming into the world of the game.

cards.title: Apps Screen
cards.desc:
# Apps Screen

This screen showcases all the apps with their name and respective icon. The top will showcase your phone percentage (infinite as of now), and the amount of bars you have.

cards.title: Socialink
cards.desc:
**Social Link**

Social Link is a phone feature that allows players to quickly exchange contact information with one another, similar to the contact sharing features found on modern smartphones.

When two characters are near each other, they can use Social Link by opening the feature on their phones and holding their devices close together. Once the connection is established, both players can instantly exchange their contact information without manually entering names or details.

To use Social Link:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Social Link**.
3. Have the other player open Social Link as well.
4. Hold the phones close together.
5. Confirm the connection request.

After a successful exchange, both characters will be added to each other's Contacts list automatically. From there, they can send messages, stay connected, and access any future phone features that require a saved contact.

Social Link is the primary way to meet new people and build your network in game, making it quick and convenient to connect with new friends you encounter throughout the world.

cards.title: Line
cards.desc:
# Line App

The primary way of communication over the phone, and the first app in the roster. It opens up to a screen of your saved contacts, allowing you to direct message them at any time. The messages can send **cross-server**, so feel free to message your friends even if they're in a different server. Messages are time-stamped according to the time ingame when sent, and messages 1 day or more apart will be designated with their date at the start of a conversation.

### Blocking contacts:

Clicking line then opening up messages, on the top right there will be a block icon. Once that is clicked it will turn red and that player would be unable to contact you until you unblock them. You will also be unable to contact them until you unblock them

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a7ce45a34d0d8d8ca06f909/attachments/6a80c79f9a7484582eb6536f/previews/6a80c7a09a7484582eb65386/download/image.webp)

cards.title: Japanify
cards.desc: **Japanify** is your built in music collection, allowing players to browse and listen to music with ease. You can view your **liked songs**, explore **playlists**, listen to music from your favorite **artists**, and search for **recently added songs**, all from one convenient interface. It's designed to make discovering and organizing music simple while enhancing your in game experience.

cards.title: Dial
cards.desc:
# Dial App

The dial app will open up to a screen of a text box at the top, where you can input anyones **phone number** and be able to call them. There will also be text at the bottom directing you to Socialink, along with a button to send you there.

cards.title: Yenapp
cards.desc:
**Yen**

The Yen app is the game's digital payment platform, allowing players to send and receive yen instantly through their phones. Similar to modern mobile payment services, Yen makes it easy to transfer money between players without needing to exchange cash in person.

When setting up the app, players choose a unique **Yen Tag**, which acts as their personal payment username. Other players can search for this tag to find and send money to them.

To use Yen:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Yen**.
3. Search for a player's Yen Tag or select a saved contact.
4. Enter the amount you wish to send.
5. Confirm the payment.

Features include:

- **Yen Tag** – A unique username used to identify your account.
- **Send Payments** – Transfer yen directly to other players.
- **Receive Payments** – Other players can send yen to your Yen Tag.
- **Transaction History** – View previous payments, transfers, and receipts.
- **Tag Search** – Search for other players using their Yen Tag to quickly send money.

The app keeps a record of your payment activity, allowing you to review past transactions and track where your money has been sent or received. This makes it useful for paying friends, splitting expenses, buying items, repaying debts, conducting business, or receiving wages from other players.

The Yen app provides a fast and convenient way to manage your finances and move money throughout the game world without needing to meet face to face.

cards.title: Contacts
cards.desc:
# Contacts App

The contacts app will open up to a screen of your saved contacts, along with the ability to press on them to open up 4 options. Those options being:

**Call - Calls your contact.**

**Message - Open up the message app and the chat with your contact.**

**Rename - Allows you to change the name of your contact.**

**Delete - Removes the contact from your phone.**

cards.title: Dial
cards.desc:
**Dial**

The Dial app functions like a standard phone keypad, allowing players to place phone calls to people in their Contacts list.

To use Dial:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Dial**.
3. Enter a phone number.
4. Press the call button to start the call.

When a call is placed, the recipient will receive an incoming call notification on their phone and can choose to answer or ignore the call. If the call is answered, both players can communicate through the phone regardless of their location in the game world.

The Dial app provides a direct way to contact other players making it useful for coordinating activities, discussing plans, or simply having a conversation.

cards.title: Calls
cards.desc:
# Calls App

The calls app will open up to a screen of a list of the recent calls you've had. They will have the other persons name, the time and date when the call was placed, and whether or not it was you or the other person who made the call.

**Incoming - Other person made call.**

**Outgoing - You made the call.**

You will also have the option to click one of the calls, with three options.

**Call Back - Call the other person.**

**Message - Send a message to that person.**

**Save Contact - Allows you to save and name that person in your contacts list.**

cards.title: Recents
cards.desc:
**Recent**

The Recent app keeps a history of your most recent phone activity, allowing you to quickly access people you've recently communicated with.

The Recent list automatically records:

- Incoming calls
- Outgoing calls
- How long calls lasted

To use Recent:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Recent**.
3. Browse your recent activity.
4. Select an entry to view available options.

From the Recent menu, players can:

- **Call Back** – Instantly place a call to the selected number or contact.
- **Message** – Open a conversation and send a text message.
- **Save Contact** – Add the number to your Contacts list if it is not already saved.

The Recent app is designed to make communication faster and more convenient, allowing players to reconnect with people they've recently interacted with without needing to manually search for them in Contacts.

cards.title: Games
cards.desc:
# Games App

The games app will open up to a screen of eight games, which when pressed will allow you to play that game. The games are as follows:

‌

- **Snake - Command a snake to get dots to grow yourself.**
- **Flappy - Flap up and down through pipes and avoid hitting them.**
- **Pong - Bounce a ball left and right and try not to let it hit your side. Players control the blue side.**
- **Tetris - Move around shapes to attempt to fill in a line and clear it.**
- **Breakout - Bounce a ball up and down to break walls above.**
- **Connect Four - Put in chips in a board to attempt to make 4 slots connect, resulting in victory. Players control the red chips.**
- **Jumper - Players control a jumping dot to bounce up platforms and try not to fall down.**
- **React - Players test their reaction speed with a timed signal, the screen flashing green. Their record is recorded.**
- **2048 - Players move squares around to combine them, trying to get the highest score by combining the most squares.**
- **Space - Players move a spaceship to shoot aliens coming down.**

cards.title: Information
cards.desc:
**Information**

The Information app provides an overview of your phone account and personal statistics. It serves as a quick reference page where players can view important details about their character and phone usage.

The Information screen displays:

- **Phone Number** – Your character's unique phone number.
- **Current Yen Balance** – The amount of yen currently available to your character.
- **Total Contacts** – The total number of contacts currently saved on your phone.
- **Total Calls Made** – A running count of all phone calls placed by your character.
- **Total Call Time** – The cumulative amount of time spent on phone calls throughout your character's lifetime.
- **Total Messages Sent** – A running count of all text messages sent through the messaging system.

The Information app is useful for keeping track of your finances, viewing your communication statistics, monitoring your social network, and checking your phone information at a glance.

As your character continues to meet new people, add contacts, make calls, send messages, work jobs, and earn money, the Information page will automatically update to reflect your latest account information and lifetime activity statistics.

cards.title: My Phone
cards.desc:
# My Phone App

The phone app is an information app, opening up to a screen with several stats relating to your phone.

It has your phone number which you can share to others, how much yen you have, how many contacts you have, how many messages you've sent, how many calls you've had, and your total call time. Your phone model is also included, but it is always FOMA 902i.

cards.title: Mixi
cards.desc:
**Mixi**

Mixi is the game's social media platform, allowing players to share their thoughts, experiences, and updates with others. Similar to modern social networking apps, Mixi provides a space where players can create posts, interact with content, and stay connected with the community.

To use Mixi:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Mixi**.
3. Create a post or browse the feed.
4. Interact with posts by liking or replying to them.

Players can use Mixi to share anything from daily thoughts and life updates to roleplay moments, achievements, announcements, and conversations with other players.

Features include:

- **Create Posts** – Share thoughts, updates, and status messages.
- **Like Posts** – Show appreciation for content posted by others.
- **Reply to Posts** – Join discussions and conversations directly beneath a post.
- **Browse the Feed** – View posts from other players and stay up to date with what's happening in the world.

Mixi serves as a digital social hub where players can express themselves, build relationships, participate in community discussions, and follow the activities of other characters throughout the game world.

cards.title: Socialink
cards.desc:
# Socialink App

The Socialink app is primarily used for getting the contacts of others you meet in person. Opening the app will lead to a dark screen and a radar symbol at the top, searching for others using Socialink.

When another person opens the Socialink app near you, their number will pop up on your screen (and yours for their screen). You have the option to click this number and add them as a contact.

cards.title: Camera
cards.desc:
**Camera**

The Camera app allows players to take photos using their in game phone.

To use it:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Camera**.
3. Switch between 3 different custom filters for different vibes.
4. Switch between **front** and **back** camera.
5. Take a photo.

- **Back Camera** – Captures the world, environments, and other players.
- **Front Camera** – Takes selfies of your character.

Photos can be taken instantly anywhere in the world.

---

**Saving Photos (Roblox Captures)**

After taking a photo, players can save it to Roblox:

1. Open the photo preview.
2. Select **Save to Captures**.

The image is stored in your **Roblox Captures** and can be accessed outside the game through your Roblox account.

cards.title: Mixi
cards.desc:
# Mixi App

Opening the Mixi App will lead to a screen where you choose your profile picture, having a symbol option and 2 color options. There are 21 symbols to choose, and you are able to change the color of the symbol and the color of the background. Dark and light orange are the default colors.

After changing your profile picture, you have the option to post on the Mixi app about anything. It is a social media app, and it is global across servers. You have the option to make a new post, or open up an existing post. You can like the post and/or comment on the post.

cards.title: Weather
cards.desc: **Weather App** is a simple application that allows players to view the current in game weather conditions. This is especially useful for roleplay, letting players plan activities or adapt to changing weather without having to wait and see it in game. It provides a quick and convenient way to check the forecast at any time.

cards.title: Japanify
cards.desc:
# Japanify App

The Japanify app is a music app, opening up to a list of several options. Liked songs, playlists, all songs, artists, recently played, and search. Songs will automatically be played to headphones if you are wearing them, and instead be played on speaker if you are not.

cards.title: Camera

The camera app allows people to take pictures either as a selfie or infront of them. There are multiple filters, and the camera app also has a specific job of school picture-taking related to it.

cards.title: Indeed

The Indeed App is the main place for jobs, which you will earn **Yen** through doing so. Jobs are only part-time, and they do not last through multiple days. The current jobs are:

 **Gakumart - Work at the Gakumart, protecting the store and servicing customers.**

**School Newspaper - Work as a picture taker for the school newspaper, taking pictures of either students or different locations.**

cards.title: Yenapp
cards.desc:
# Yenapp

Yenapp is the main banking app for everyone, storing Yen and allowing the transfer of it. You will be asked to create a Yen Tag which people can use for transferring or requesting money, to which you will gain access to your bank. The activity button will lead you to a screen of all recent money related activities, such as payments, purchases, and transfers. You can also put in another person Yen Tag to either send them money or send a request for money.

cards.title: Taxi
cards.desc:
The Taxi App is a fast travel feature accessible directly through the player's in-game flip phone. It allows players to quickly navigate the map by calling a cab to transport them to key locations across the city and school grounds, eliminating long travel times and avoiding unwanted ambushes.

Key Features & Mechanics Phone Integration:

Accessible via the flip phone menu under the Taxi icon. Fast Travel Locations: Select from a list of designated drop-off points (e.g., School Gates, City Center, Gym, Local Shops, Gang Turf).

Cost / Fee: 200 YEN

Get near the taxi and it will display a "Get In Front Seat - Get In Back Seat to start" option along with the 200 Yen Waiver Fee included in the text bubble.

Cooldown / Restrictions:

Cannot be used while in active combat or staggered.

Upon reaching your destination, a confirmation message showing the details of your trip will be shown.

Additionally, there is a "TAXI" app on the phone. Using it will allow you to call an available taxi from anywhere on the map at the cost of ¥100, as well as viewing your taxi ride history.
